summary: Port canonical additive retrieval scoring to web; end web/pipeline scoring divergence

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: Grounded in guru/retriever.py (canonical pipeline retriever) + export.py. Decision: port the pipeline's additive model rather than invent RRF or a calibrated multiplicative formula. Formula: score = 0.7*sim + 0.3*max(tierW, graphScore) + diversity. Weights HARDCODED to pipeline defaults (user decision): vector_weight=0.7, graph_weight=0.3, tier verified/proposed/inferred = 1.0/0.7/0.4, diversity_boost=0.1, max_per_tradition=3. Vector hits get explicit tier='inferred' (fixes 3251a8d6 silent-0.4). Graph leg contributes via graph_weight*max(tierW,graphScore), an independent additive term — no fake 0.5 distance (fixes 0a771923). Diversity gets a hard per-tradition cap + a rarity-aware first-pass boost, going beyond canonical which is still first-seen (fixes ce844add). No edge weights used: corpus has none.

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: BASELINE from eval harness (current multiplicative scoring, live corpus) CORRECTS the earlier 'graph leg is structurally suppressed' framing. Reality: Bug1 and Bug2 INTERACT so the graph leg DOMINATES. Vector tier silently=0.4 (Bug1) makes a vector chunk score ~0.65*0.4=0.26, while a graph chunk scores 0.5(flat dist)*0.7(real proposed tier)=0.35 — so graph OUTSCORES vector. Result: graph-sourced = 144/180 = 80% of top-K slots, and 7/12 queries fall BELOW the 3-tradition coverage target (graph floods single traditions: 'union with God'=1 trad, 'logos'=1 trad). The 2 queries where graph stayed dark (vector-only) had the BEST coverage (4 and 7 traditions). Predictions to verify post-fbf4652f: additive 0.7*sim/0.3*graph rebalances toward vector; max_per_tradition=3 cap should push 'below coverage target' from 7/12 toward ~0-2 and drop graph share from 80% to ~30-50%. Re-run scripts/eval-retrieval.ts to confirm.

resolution.note: Retrieval scoring redesign shipped. Ported guru/retriever.py additive model to mergeAndRerank (0.7/0.3 weights, explicit inferred tier on vector, independent graph term, per-tradition cap), added rarity-aware diversity, an eval harness, opt-in score trace, and unit tests. Harness before/after on 12 canonical queries: avg distinct traditions/top-K 3.58->6.17, queries below 3-tradition target 7/12->0/12, graph-sourced share 80%->14% (rebalanced; cross-tradition coverage now from the cap, not a scoring bug). Closes 3251a8d6, 0a771923, ce844add. Deferred: edges.weight (9f401f76), concept-extraction (53480da1).
